qcbot.name: qcbot
qcbot.description: qcbot is a web crawler used by QUIC.cloud to fetch data from websites for various online services including image optimization, CSS optimization, and other website performance features. The bot retrieves content from sites, processes it through QUIC.cloud services, and then notifies the site when optimized resources are ready to be retrieved.

qualifiedbot.description: QualifiedBot is Qualified's web crawler that analyzes customer websites to provide contextual information for their AI-powered chatbots and conversational marketing platform.

quora-bot.name: Quora-Bot
quora-bot.description: Quora-Bot is a web crawler operated by Quora, a question-and-answer platform where users can ask questions and get answers from the community. This bot fetches web content to support various platform features, such as generating link previews when users share URLs in questions or answers, or gathering information to enhance content quality on the platform.

qwantbot.name: Qwantbot
qwantbot.description: Qwantbot is the web crawler for Qwant, the French privacy-focused search engine. Based in Europe, it indexes websites while prioritizing user privacy and data protection, offering search results without tracking users.

qwantbot-official.name: Qwantbot-official
qwantbot-official.description: Qwantbot-official is the web crawler for Qwant, a European search engine that indexes web pages to include them in search results. This bot visits websites to discover and collect content for Qwant's search index.

qwarrybot.name: Qwarrybot
qwarrybot.description: Qwarrybot is a web crawler operated by Qwarry, a French advertising technology company that provides contextual targeting and audience analysis services for programmatic advertising campaigns. The bot analyzes web content to understand page topics and audiences for cookieless ad targeting across multiple channels.
